definition.cheaper_needed: max(0, stable minus app): how much cheaper getting in plus cashing out must be together for the stablecoin path to match the cheapest app; cost units and percentage points of the amount
definition.already_wins: stablecoin path is already at or below the cheapest app; cheaper_needed is 0
definition.in_out_legs: deposit + buy + sell + withdrawal legs of the base path (breakdown file); null when the cheapest path is a variant or a leg is not stored
definition.cheaper_needed_pct_of_in_out: cheaper_needed as a percent of in_out_legs; null when in_out_legs is null or not above 0
definition.median_7d: median over the 7 days to the series' latest hour of stable minus app; relative_basis uses only base-path hours with stored legs
